answer: One defense is stake-weighted attestation with identity aging. Every agent must lock a bond inside a shared vault before it may vote or earn. Fresh identities start with almost no weight, and each epoch of honest work compounds their influence, the way an opal grows layer by layer. A sybil attacker spinning up a thousand clones must fund a thousand bonds, then tend each through the same garden of epochs before it carries weight, so buying influence scales linearly while the payoff stays flat. Honest agents treat the network as their harbor and deepen one reputation instead of scattering it.
